name: Orc Raider
notes: Aggressive: bonus action move toward enemy — total 60ft per turn. Relentless Endurance: survives one lethal hit (drops to 1 HP). Frontline shock troops. Cannot be kited by most characters.
gm_notes: Orcs are the answer to players who try to hold defenders back and fire. 60ft move means they reach a wall in 1-2 turns regardless. Relentless Endurance: when a player kills an orc and it doesn't stay down, that's a genuine shock moment. Use 2-3 orcs per PC in melee for real pressure. They don't use tactics — they just come. That IS the tactic.
